verdict.rationale: E2B documents a sandbox timeout that developers can change at runtime with `setTimeout`/`set_timeout`, which resets it to the new value. The sandbox shuts down when the timeout expires, and `kill` can end it earlier. Sessions are also hard-capped at 1 hour (Base) or 24 hours (Pro), and the CLI can shut down one or all running sandboxes. missing for 10: an idle-based (inactivity) timeout rather than a wall-clock timeout, an explicit statement that billing stops on timeout or shutdown, evidence of setting the timeout at creation time, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
